name: nightmare
lore:
Nightmares, as described on the page for Nightmare (creature), are beings of dread and terror, often associated with the darker planes of existence. They embody the very essence of bad dreams and are capable of instilling fear in even the bravest of hearts. Their presence is often marked by a chilling aura and the palpable sense of impending doom. 

These creatures possess a range of terrifying abilities, from manipulating dreams to influencing the minds of mortals. They are often solitary entities, preferring to work from the shadows, weaving intricate webs of fear and despair. Encounters with Nightmares are rarely straightforward, often involving psychological manipulation and harrowing visions designed to break the spirit of their victims.

Whether serving powerful entities or pursuing their own malevolent agendas, Nightmares are a force to be reckoned with. Their existence is a constant reminder that the darkest corners of the mind can be as dangerous as any physical threat.
